degree_required.value: 40 classroom hours of approved real estate courses (salesman); 40 additional classroom hours plus 3 years as a salesman (broker)
degree_required.quote: Every individual applicant for a license as a broker who is required to take an examination therefor shall, as a prerequisite to taking such examination, submit proof satisfactory to the board that he has been actively associated with a real estate broker for a period of 3 years as a real estate salesman and that he has completed additional courses in real estate subjects approved by the board, such courses to total 40 classroom hours of instruction.

degree_level.quote: Every individual applicant for a license as a salesman who is required to take an examination therefor shall, as a prerequisite to taking such examination, submit proof satisfactory to the board that he has completed courses in real estate subjects approved by the board, such courses to total 40 classroom hours of instruction

exams.name: Real Estate Broker Written Examination
exams.notes: Conducted by the board or an independent testing service designated by the board. Attorneys at law of the commonwealth are exempt. Examinations held at least 6 times per calendar year for broker's examinations.
exams.jurisdiction: state (board or designated independent testing service)
exams.quote: no license to engage as a broker or salesman shall be issued to any applicant unless he has complied with all the pertinent provisions of this section and sections eighty-seven TT to eighty-seven DDD, inclusive, and if the applicant is an individual, unless he shall have satisfactorily passed a written examination conducted by the board or an independent testing service designated by the board

interval_years.quote: a license shall be valid for a period of two years from the date of issue unless sooner suspended or revoked and shall be renewed by the board biennially thereafter, without examination

required.quote: Any person holding a license as a real estate broker or salesman, which is subject to renewal on or after January first, nineteen hundred and ninety-nine, shall, within twenty-four months prior to each renewal, satisfactorily complete courses or programs of instruction approved by the board

hours_per_period.quote: for licenses renewed on or after January first, two thousand and one, such number shall be no less than six hours but no more than twelve hours as determined by the board

period_years.quote: within twenty-four months prior to each renewal, satisfactorily complete courses or programs of instruction approved by the board

topical_requirements.quote: The curriculum contained in such courses or programs shall contain at least six hours of instruction concerning or related to compliance with laws and regulations selected from any of the following subjects: fair housing; equal employment opportunity; accessibility for the disabled; agency law; environmental issues in real estate; zoning and building codes; real estate appraisal and financing; property tax assessments and valuation; and real estate board regulations.

available.quote: the board may exempt from the written examination prescribed in section eighty-seven SS a broker or salesman duly licensed in any other state of the United States under the laws of which a similar exemption is extended to licensed brokers and salesmen of the commonwealth.

requirements.value: Non-residents may be licensed upon conforming to all pertinent provisions. The board may exempt non-residents from the written examination if their home state extends a similar reciprocal exemption to MA licensees. Out-of-state licensees receiving reciprocity must demonstrate compliance with a continuing education program in their home state.
requirements.quote: A non-resident may be licensed as a broker and a non-resident individual may be licensed as a salesman upon conforming to all pertinent provisions of sections eighty-seven PP to eighty-seven DDD, inclusive; provided, that the board may exempt from the written examination prescribed in section eighty-seven SS a broker or salesman duly licensed in any other state of the United States under the laws of which a similar exemption is extended to licensed brokers and salesmen of the commonwealth.

title_protection.quote: Whoever, without being licensed as required by section eighty-seven RR, acts as a broker or salesman or advertises that he is a broker or salesman shall be punished by a fine of not more than five hundred dollars.

scope_protection.quote: Whoever, without being licensed as required by section eighty-seven RR, acts as a broker or salesman or advertises that he is a broker or salesman shall be punished by a fine of not more than five hundred dollars.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License obtained by false or fraudulent representation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: may suspend, revoke or refuse to renew any license which it has found to have been obtained by false or fraudulent representation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acted in the dual capacity of broker and undisclosed principal in the same transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acted in the dual capacity of broker and undisclosed principal in the same transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acted for more than one party to a transaction without the knowledge and consent of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acted for more than one party to a transaction without the knowledge and consent of all the parties for whom he acts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed, within a reasonable time, to account for or remit moneys belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed, within a reasonable time, to account for or remit any moneys belonging to others which have come into his possession as a broker or salesman

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paid commissions or fees to or divided the same with any person required to be licensed but not so licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: paid commissions or fees to or divided the same with any person, who, being required to be licensed as a broker or salesman in this or any other state, is not so licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepted, given or charged any undisclosed commission, rebate or profit on expenditures for a principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepted, given or charged any undisclosed commission, rebate or profit on expenditures for a principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Induced any party to a contract or lease to break it for personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: induced any party to a contract or lease relating to real estate to break the same when such action is effected for the personal gain of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingled the money or other property of principal with licensee's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commingled the money or other property of his principal with his own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to give to both the buyer and seller a copy of the purchase and sale agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to give to both the buyer and seller a copy of the purchase and sale agreement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed any act expressly prohibited in the real estate broker statutes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed any act expressly prohibited in sections eighty-seven RR to eighty-seven CCC, inclusive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affirmatively solicited for sale or listing on grounds of alleged change of value due to race, economic level, religion, or ethnic origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: affirmatively solicited for sale, lease, or the listing for sale or lease, of residential property on the grounds of alleged change of value due to the presence or the prospective entry into the neighborhood of a person or persons of another race, economic level, religion or ethnic origin

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepted a net listing agreement from a prospective seller
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepted from a prospective seller a net listing, an agreement to sell real estate for a stated price which authorized the broker to keep as commission any amount of money received from the sale of said real estate in excess of the stated price

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a criminal offence demonstrating lack of good moral character
disciplinary_grounds.quote: been convicted of a criminal offence by a court of competent jurisdiction of this or any other state which demonstrates his lack of good moral character to act as a broker or salesman

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission finding of unlawful practice in violation of anti-discrimination law arising from licensed activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Massachusetts commission against discrimination that said commission has made a finding, which finding has become final, that a licensed broker or salesman committed an unlawful practice in violation of chapter one hundred and fifty-one B arising out of or in the course of his occupation as a licensed broker or salesman

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to give written notice to the board of any change of business location
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to give such notice shall be grounds for the revocation of such license.

bonding_required.quote: No broker's license shall be issued or renewed until the applicant gives to the board a bond in the form approved by said board in the sum of five thousand dollars, executed by the applicant and by a surety company authorized to do business within the commonwealth, or by the applicant and by two good and sufficient sureties approved by the board.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A licensed resident broker shall maintain a usual place of business in the commonwealth and shall display conspicuously therein or in any branch thereof his license or a certified copy thereof.

license_tiers.quote: No license to engage as a broker or salesman shall be issued to any applicant unless he has complied with all the pertinent provisions of this section

broker_of_record_required.quote: An application for a broker's license by a corporation, society, association or partnership shall designate at least one of its officers or partners as its representative for the purpose of obtaining its said license, and each such officer or partner so designated shall apply to the board for a broker's license in his own name at the same time unless he is already a licensed broker.

required_instruction_topics.quote: In determining competence the board shall require proof that the applicant has a fair understanding of the principles of real estate practice, real estate agreements and principal and agent relations, of the rudimentary principles of the economics and appraising of real estate, and of the provisions of sections eighty-seven PP to eighty-seven DDD, inclusive.

agency_relationship_types.quote: A real estate broker or salesman may provide services as a facilitator who does not represent a buyer or seller and who does not act in an agency capacity.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A real estate broker or salesperson may act as a dual agent who represents both prospective purchasers and sellers only with the informed written consent of the prospective purchasers and sellers.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: a real estate broker or salesman may appoint one or more licensees to act as a designated agent on behalf of a purchaser and may appoint one or more other licensees to act as a designated agent on behalf of a seller for a potential real estate transaction.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: A real estate broker or salesman may provide services as a facilitator who does not represent a buyer or seller and who does not act in an agency capacity.

sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: At the time of the signing of the first written contract to purchase, real estate brokers and salesmen, or the seller if no broker or salesperson is involved in the sale, shall distribute a brochure, published by the office of consumer affairs and business regulations, educating consumers about the home inspection process.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: No salesman may conduct or operate his own real estate business nor act except as the representative of a real estate broker who shall be responsible for the salesman

promotional_land_sales_registration_requ.quote: No broker shall engage in a sale in the commonwealth of real property located in a land development in another state which is the subject of promotional advertising in the commonwealth unless the owner or developer of such land has submitted to the board full particulars regarding such land
